# scripts/ops/Initialize-AvdGraphApp.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

One-time setup of the "avd-opsbot" app registration, so operators sign in to Microsoft Graph once per Cloud Shell session with no consent prompts (decision 0016).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-OperatorsGroup` | string | no | `'AVD Admins'` | Group (display name or object ID) whose members may sign in through the app. Skipped with a warning if it doesn't exist. |
| `-TenantId` | string | no |  | Tenant to set up; defaults to the Azure context's tenant, else your home tenant. |
| `-AppName` | string | no | `'avd-opsbot'` |  |
| `-SaveToProfile` | switch | no |  |  |
